articles.title: Tether Billionaire Enters UK's Richest People List Amid Farage Gift Inquiry
articles.snippet: Christopher Harborne’s Rich List debut comes as Reform UK's Nigel Farage faces scrutiny over a $6.7 million gift from the Tether investor.
